title: No Cheat Progelato
headline: Seven flavours. One visual family.
summary: A seven-flavour packaging range for No Cheat Progelato, presented through pouch artwork, individual mockups, and a cohesive full-family visual.
overview: A seven-flavour packaging range designed as a unified visual family. A shared structural hierarchy connects the entire lineup—anchored by a consistent brand crest, high-contrast claims badges, and central dessert illustration—while flavour-specific colour-blocking and ingredient cues provide instantaneous shelf differentiation.
